summary: This directory provides standardized cryptographic hashing utilities to compute SHA-256 signatures for both raw data inputs and filesystem-based resources, supporting consistent identification of content within the application.
responsibilities: Computing SHA-256 hash digests from string and byte array inputs
Generating file-specific hash representations from local storage paths
Producing truncated hash variants for shortened identifier requirements
relationships: The hashing functions transform raw data or file content into fixed-length hexadecimal strings.
Shortened hash variants are derived directly from the primary SHA-256 calculation logic.
designDecisions: Exposure of a unified interface for both memory-based and file-based hashing operations
Standardization on the SHA-256 algorithm for consistent output generation
